title: Classic Italian Affogato: Vanilla Ice Cream Drowned in Espresso
summary: Very cold vanilla ice cream is scooped into frozen bowls and drowned in freshly brewed hot espresso, then eaten at once.

ingredients.item: very cold vanilla ice cream or gelato
freshly brewed hot espresso (2 double shots) or strong moka-pot coffee

steps.title: Freeze the bowls
steps.text: Chill the bowls in the freezer for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Brew
steps.text: Make the espresso before you scoop.

steps.title: Scoop
steps.text: Place 2 firm scoops of ice cream in each bowl.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the hot espresso over the ice cream in a thin stream.

tips: Freezer-cold ice cream and frozen bowls stop it melting into soup.
Use freshly brewed coffee; reheated coffee tastes flat.
A good dense gelato gives the best contrast.
storage: Assemble only when ready to eat; it cannot be made ahead.
